title: The Signature Swarm Robotics Laboratory Database

entries.title: The Trail Layer
entries.subject: A Signature design for laying scent trails that robot swarms can follow.

entries.title: The Best-Spot Seeker
entries.subject: A Signature design for a seeker that steers between its own best and the swarm's best.

entries.title: The Dance Floor
entries.subject: A Signature design for a floor where robot bees dance to advertise good sources.

entries.title: The Tabletop Thousand
entries.subject: A Signature design for a thousand-robot tabletop swarm experiment.

entries.title: The Puck School
entries.subject: A Signature design for a school of identical puck robots that test swarm rules.

entries.title: The Marker Garden
entries.subject: A Signature design for a garden of markers that robots plant and follow.

entries.title: The Docking Chain
entries.subject: A Signature design for robots that link into chains and bridges.

entries.title: The Pattern Watcher
entries.subject: A Signature design for watching order appear from local rules.

entries.title: The Gradient Gardener
entries.subject: A Signature design for growing robot shapes from a seed signal.

entries.title: The Scent Map
entries.subject: A Signature design for a map drawn in fading scent.

entries.title: The Mound Builder
entries.subject: A Signature design for a termite-style builder that raises walls one pellet at a time.

entries.title: The Tube Pruner
entries.subject: A Signature design for growing networks and pruning the useless tubes.

entries.title: The Blink Choir
entries.subject: A Signature design for a choir of robots that blink in unison.

entries.title: The School Keeper
entries.subject: A Signature design for keeping a robot school together while it surveys.

entries.title: The Murmuration Rig
entries.subject: A Signature design for a rig that flies drone flocks like starling murmurations.

entries.title: The Fast Bench
entries.subject: A Signature design for a bench that simulates a thousand robots faster than real time.

entries.title: The Swarm Atlas
entries.subject: A Signature design for an atlas that holds every swarm rule in one book.

entries.title: The Arena Keeper
entries.subject: A Signature design for a laboratory arena that resets itself between experiments.

entries.title: The Sense Weaver
entries.subject: A Signature design for weaving many small sensor readings into one picture.

entries.title: The Harvest Trail
entries.subject: A Signature design for a trail that leads a swarm to scattered items and home again.

entries.title: The Cluster Bell
entries.subject: A Signature design for a bell that gathers a scattered swarm into one cluster.

entries.title: The Even Spreader
entries.subject: A Signature design for spreading robots evenly so no patch is watched twice.

entries.title: The Shape Choir
entries.subject: A Signature design for a choir that sings robots into letters and shapes.

entries.title: The Graceful Degrader
entries.subject: A Signature design for a swarm that fades gently instead of collapsing when robots fail.
